metadata.title: Predicting adolescents’ environmental action: From individual to national-level factors using an explainable machine learning approach

design_fields.q1_rationale: The dependent variables are behavioral/action items rather than PISA cognitive achievement scales with Plausible Values, making PV handling not applicable.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses PISA 2018 microdata with a two-stage stratified probability-proportional-to-size design and reports weighted response rates, indicating that sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study examines factors at individual, school, and national levels, suggesting that it appropriately accounts for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
